accompany.def: to go somewhere with someone as a companion

accurate.ex: Her accurate calculations saved us time.

achieve.def: to reach a goal by effort, skill, or courage

achievement.def: a thing done successfully with effort, skill, or courage

acknowledge.def: to accept or admit the existence or truth of

acquire.def: to buy or obtain an asset or object for oneself

across.def: from one side to the other side of something

action.def: the fact or process of doing something

active.ex: She leads an active and healthy lifestyle.

activity.def: a condition in which things are happening or being done

actual.def: existing in fact; typically as contrasted with what was intended

actually.def: as the truth or facts of a situation; really

adapt.def: to become adjusted to new conditions

add.def: to join something to something else so as to increase size or number
add.ex: Add a little salt to the soup.

addition.def: the action or process of adding something

address.def: the particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated

admire.def: to regard with respect or warm approval

admit.def: to confess to be true or to be the case
admit.ex: He refused to admit his mistake.

adopt.def: to choose to take up, follow, or use

advance.def: to move forward, typically in a purposeful way

advantage.def: a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable position

adventure.def: an unusual and exciting, typically hazardous, experience

advice.def: guidance or recommendations offered with regard to prudent future action

advise.def: to offer suggestions about the best course of action to someone

affect.def: to have an effect on; make a difference to

afraid.ex: Don't be afraid of making mistakes.

after.def: in the time following an event or another period of time

again.ex: Could you please repeat that again?

against.ex: He stood with his back against the wall.

age.def: the length of time that a person or thing has existed

agreement.def: harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling
agreement.ex: Both parties signed the peace agreement.

ahead.def: further forward in space or time

aid.def: help, typically of a practical or financial nature

aim.def: a purpose or intention; a desired outcome

air.def: the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth

alive.ex: He felt truly alive while exploring nature.

all.def: the whole quantity or extent of

allow.def: to give someone permission to do something

almost.ex: We are almost at the destination.

already.def: before or by now or the time in question

also.ex: She is not only smart but also kind.

always.def: at all times; on all occasions

ancient.def: belonging to the very distant past

angry.def: feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure

animal.def: a living organism that feeds on organic matter

author.def: a writer of a book, article, or document

beautiful.def: pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically

beauty.def: a combination of qualities that pleases the aesthetic senses

become.def: to begin to be; grow into

believe.def: to accept that something is true, especially without proof

brave.def: ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage

breathe.def: to take air into the lungs and expel it

bright.def: giving out or reflecting a lot of light; shining

bring.def: to take or go with someone or something to a place

build.def: to construct something by putting parts or materials together

calm.def: not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions

character.def: a person in a novel, play, or movie; moral nature

courage.def: the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery

create.ex: Writers create entire worlds with words.

curious.def: eager to know or learn something

discover.def: to find unexpectedly or in the course of a search

dream.def: a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in mind during sleep

explore.def: to travel in or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it

freedom.def: the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants

delight.ex: Reading classic literature brings great delight.

elegant.def: pleasingly graceful and stylish in appearance or manner

glory.def: high renown or honor won by notable achievements

grace.def: simple elegance or refinement of movement

happiness.def: the state of being happy; feeling pleasure

harmony.def: agreement or concord; pleasing arrangement of parts

hope.def: a feeling of expectation and desire for a certain thing to happen

inspire.def: to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something

knowledge.def: facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education

literature.def: written works, especially those considered of superior or lasting artistic merit
literature.ex: He spent his life studying classic literature.

library.def: a building or room containing collections of books and periodicals
library.ex: He spent hours studying in the quiet library.

sentence.def: a set of words that is complete in itself, typically containing a subject and predicate
sentence.ex: Every sentence in this book holds deep meaning.

language.def: the method of human communication, either spoken or written
language.ex: Learning a new language opens new worlds.

volume.def: a book forming part of a work or series; degree of loudness
volume.ex: He pulled the third volume from the shelf.

prose.def: written or spoken language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure
prose.ex: His prose was praised for its clarity and rhythm.
